name: Freshsales
shortInfo: Freshsales Connector enables streaming relevant Freshsales performance data into a user determined data warehouse.
brief: Freshsales is Sales CRM that helps you engage with customers, automate sales processes, manage prospects, visualise progress of deals, enhance productivity and measure sales performance.
about:
Freshsales is a cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) solution that helps businesses across different industry verticals to manage their interactions with existing and potential customers.

Check more about api doc [here](https://developer.freshsales.io/api/).
